title: Kyiv National Academic Theatre of Operetta
summary: The Kyiv National Academic Theatre of Operetta is a prominent theatre located in Kyiv, Ukraine, established in 1934. It plays a significant role in the cultural landscape of Ukraine, particularly in the genre of operetta.

sections.heading: Foundation and History
paragraphs: The Kyiv National Academic Theatre of Operetta was founded in 1934, marking its establishment as a key institution for performing arts [[coal-in-ukraine|in Ukraine]].

sections.heading: Cultural Significance
paragraphs: As a national theatre, it contributes to the rich cultural heritage of [[ukraine|Ukraine]], focusing on the operetta genre, which combines elements of opera and musical theatre.

sections.heading: Location
paragraphs: The theatre is situated in [[kyiv|Kyiv]], the capital city of Ukraine, serving as a central hub for theatrical performances and cultural events.
